title: YouTube channel description
content: Chill Crew is a shonen-style animated series about four kids at King Middle whose emotions show up as fire, lightning, mist and stone — and who are teaching each other to use them instead of getting used by them. New episodes every Thursday. Shorts every Tuesday. Made by McCray Learning Lab.

title: Recurring beat: Sunday still-teaser
content: One still from next episode posted the Sunday before, with no caption at all — repeat every week of the season.

title: Positioning (Launch Campaign)
content: Two audiences: kids (the show itself, no SEL language in kid-facing captions) and parents/educators (the CASEL framing, the one-pager, the educator email). Keep the two voices separate — a kid caption never says "competency" or "CASEL".
